Manifest.Name: Eleanor Story Expand / 上层区的富家千金爱上在下层区开当铺的我：埃莉诺剧情扩展
Manifest.Author: EleanorRomance Team
Manifest.Description: 1.29 fixes Lydia's paid closure date: if the pre-opening date was staged but never displayed, it is now queued through the native arrival path, and stale pending/current client state is recovered. It also restores Eleanor's self-refilling perfume as an immediate native counter reward on every successful ending, including solo romance, maid v2, revolution and old saves, and the fake-uncle warning gift now uses the native EleanorWarned free-reward barter UI with native ownership transfer. The latest text pass includes the chapter-20 confession option wording, the revolution answers and Japanese/Korean localization sync. The 1.28 Security channel and maid localization fixes, 1.27 Serpico delay, 1.26 polish and earlier fixes remain. Story routes, outcomes, target days and endings are unchanged. 1.29 修复莉迪亚闭店约会：当开店前约会已排入但未显示时，改走原生到店队列并清理过期的待处理/当前客户状态。恢复自我补充香水为所有成功结局的直接原生柜台奖励，覆盖单人恋爱、侍从 v2、革命军与旧存档；假叔叔警告谢礼改用原版 EleanorWarned 自由奖励 barter 界面与原生归属转移。本版同时收录第 20 章告白选项文案、革命军回答与日/韩本地化同步。保留 1.28 治安部渠道与侍从线本地化、1.27 Serpico 顺延、1.26 文案收尾及更早修复。不改路线、选项结果、目标日或结局。简体中文 / English / 日本語 / 한국어。
